description: Distort items by moving the corners of their bounding box, as the Free Transform tool's Free Distort and Perspective Distort do. free: give corners as [x, y] fractions of the box (0,0 top-left, 1,1 bottom-right). perspective: one edge narrows (positive amount) or widens (negative) symmetrically. Applied as the Free Distort effect; expand (default) makes it plain artwork

amount.description: perspective: percent of the width (or height) each corner moves inward; negative moves outward

corners.description: free: new corner positions; corners left out stay put. E.g. { topRight: [1.2, -0.1] }

edge.description: perspective: the edge whose corners move

expand.description: Expand the effect into plain artwork. Default true

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: distort_items
title: Distort Items
